name: find_setting
description: Find which setting a plain-language request means on a layer (the user's own, an agent the user manages, or the whole app) and what it would change: a card with current and proposed values, or a short described pick list. Changes nothing.

request.description: The user's request in their own words.

layer.description: user: the caller's own settings; agent: this conversation's agent or `agent`; app: the whole app (administrators).

agent.description: Agent id for the agent layer; omit for this conversation's agent.
